symptom: `create or modify published rest service M.BookingApi (...) { resource 'bookings' { delete '{id}' microflow M.PRS_DeleteBooking; } }` deleted the stored GET '' and GET '{id}' and printed only `Modified published rest service`; `alter … add resource 'bookings' { … }` with the stored name passed check and exec refused it (resource 'bookings' already exists).
file: mdl/executor/validate_published_rest_ops.go droppedPublishedRestOperations / CheckPublishedRestOperationDrops (MDL-REST06, wired in cmd/mxcli/cmd_check.go and execCreatePublishedRestService) and publishedRestAlterResourceProblems (validate.go). Test: mdl/executor/validate_published_rest_ops_2449_test.go
cause: A create-or-modify replaces the service's resource list wholesale with no comparison against the stored operations; the alter's resource actions were judged only by exec.
insight: **Key an operation as describe prints it (resource + method + path with slashes trimmed)**: `get microflow`, `get ''` and `get '/'` are one operation, and keying on the raw path would warn on every describe -> exec round trip. The control is exactly that round trip: Unchanged, no warning.
